source.note: The pins reproduce the packages explicitly installed by the retained historical launcher. W&B-only observability plumbing is omitted from this standalone evaluator.

historical_boundaries.base_runtime: The final open-weight result artifact did not retain an independently attested Python, PyTorch, Triton, CUDA toolkit, driver, or container digest. These requirements therefore do not assert those versions.
historical_boundaries.evaluation_data: The historical artifact did not retain immutable revisions for the lm-eval task datasets or the identities of sampled few-shot examples. configs/lm_eval_paper_tasks.json pins new public-protocol dataset revisions and the lm-eval default seeds; these are not attributed to the historical campaign.
historical_boundaries.raw_outputs: The original per-example lm-eval outputs were not retained in the public artifact. Public quality reruns enable sample logging and preserve documents, prompt hashes, responses, and per-sample metrics in their result JSON.
historical_boundaries.revision_policy: The default public protocol pins newly selected immutable revisions for both historically unrecorded Qwen cases. Their outputs must not be described as the exact historical checkpoints.
